content: Hi, I'm using lean4export (v3.1.0) to analyze type signatures across a multi-module project. When I export individual leaf modules (e.g., lean4export MyProject.Module.File), it works if that .olean exists. But I'd like to export the entire project's declarations in one pass. Is there a recommended way to get a single ndjson export that includes all project-local declarations (without re-exporting all of Mathlib/Init)? Or is the intended workflow to export module-by-module?
